title: Implement all 60 boss identities, five modes and a synchronized in-game changelog
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Implements Grave Accord’s sixty authored boss identities across five modes, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons and six distinct arena footprints. Adds nine Endless-exclusive bosses, twelve-completed-encounter repeat protection, seeded bags that retain unchosen candidates and guaranteed exclusive choices before every fourth fight. The Uncounted is an explicit optional campaign extension; it never appears as a random Endless draw.

A Normal+ campaign with three Accord Breaks and no timeout records its victory before offering the extension. Each survivor chooses individually; only those who accept enter, while others may bank and leave. Declining, waiting or losing preserves the original clear. Local Practice records retain victories and the optional memorial; late arrivals, non-consenters and direct rehearsals cannot farm it. Protocol 12 serializes selection, campaign and participation state, migrates bounded local protocol-11 saves, shares moving-block collision with prediction and replicates reflected projectile velocity under its existing identity. Online/signed state stays strict.

Ten new signatures execute exact delayed fans, orbiting hazards and a safe orbit, reflected bullets, ordered dash trails, persistent symbol history, curved physical moth ribbons, beat-marked lanes, moving solid buildings, counted door sweeps and bounded ledger echoes/relocations/beams/summons. Adds 88 drawn motion poses, eight props and ten original themes. All fifty previous PCM masters remain byte-identical. All nineteen native returns and exact requests are preserved, including seven superseded whole sheets; independent art audits reconstruct the shipped pixels and verify transparent padding.

Validation: 244 rules/history/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL tests, authored-content/fifteen-locale checks, TypeScript and production build. Every new identity launches a real WebSocket room; new tests cover all Normal/Brutal phases, 16-player objectives, 250-fight seeded schedules, restored choices/power caps, actual Accord holds, neutral counterplay, prediction, save bounds, victory banking, consent and participation. Fifteen-language consent and symbol/beat help is included. The in-game journal, repository changelog and fifteen-page Wiki describe actual current behavior.

Keep draft and main protected. The browser control was disabled by Work settings during this stage, so no new rendered screenshot or visual acceptance is claimed for the sixty-identity build. Earlier Raid/journal screenshots remain evidence for their prior source. Complete action/facing art, final deadline/uptime and balance measurements, profiles/mastery/cosmetic presentation, verified rankings, durable deployed recovery and Windows/offline/LAN packaging remain unfinished. Human listening, physical-device/native-language, WAN/endurance and final capacity acceptance remain open. The public Site is still its older protocol-4 deployment.
